name: Rocky Linux Documentation
description: The documentation project of Rocky Linux, an enterprise Linux distribution.
summary: AI assistance is allowed in the documentation project, based on Fedora's policy. Contributors are accountable for quality and licence compliance and must disclose AI use when a significant part comes from a tool unchanged, for example with Assisted-by or document metadata.

evidence.quote: You MAY use AI assistance for contributing to the Rocky Linux Documentation Project, as long as you follow the principles described below.
You MUST disclose your use of AI tools when a significant part of your contribution comes directly from a tool without any changes.
Contributing to Rocky Linux means vouching for the quality, license compliance, and utility of your submission.

sources.title: Rocky Linux Documentation AI-assisted contribution policy
